comparison.objective: Inserts a seatpost into a 17-degree seat tube; candidate removes notched tangs from already-installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part angled insertion differs from small recessed coaxial tool alignment, bimanual impact control, and loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Seatpost fit is the only available criterion; no body or specs provide thresholds. Candidate additionally requires fracture, containment, retention, and damage avoidance.
comparison.reason: Insertion and controlled notch fracture test meaningfully different abilities.
